# Third-party files notice

**Everything in this folder was retrieved from sources publicly available online** and is kept here unchanged, so
that the wiki's citations stay verifiable even if an original location changes or disappears.

* These files are **not** covered by this repository's MIT License. Each file remains the property of its owner
  (for example the European Space Agency, CCSDS, ECSS, conference organisers, mission teams or the authors) and is
  subject to the owner's terms.
* Each file's original URL, the UTC time it was copied and its SHA-256 checksum are listed on the
  [Sources & copies](../about/sources-and-copies.md) page and on the file's [library](../library/index.md) entry.
  The checksums let you confirm that a copy is byte-identical to what was downloaded.
* This project is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the owners.
* **Rights holders:** if you would like a file removed, please open an issue at
  <https://github.com/feiteira/OPEN-SPACE-INFO/issues> and it will be taken down promptly.

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `ccsds/`, `ecss/` | CCSDS and ECSS standards, reports and adoption notices |
| `mib-icd/` | SCOS-2000 Database Import ICD issues and MIB tailoring documents |
| `core/` | SCOS-2000, EGSE and Herschel/Planck documents |
| `edds/`, `tdrs/`, `nis/`, `mission-ddid/` | Ground segment, data dissemination and mission data delivery documents |
| `context/`, `tooling/` | Papers, presentations and tool documentation |
| `solo/` | Solar Orbiter MIB releases and the SWA instrument database (zip files as published) |
